headline: 碧莉薇求償800萬律師費
context: 女演員 Blake Lively 在與 Justin Baldoni 的法律糾紛中，向法院申請追討 800 萬美元的律師費。她在就部分指控和解後，法官裁定她有資格就其中一項申請費用補償。Baldoni 及其製作公司 Wayfarer Studios 的律師被批評採取「焦土戰術」，兩方曾對她提出 4 億美元的反訴。

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: After the actress settled her retaliation claims, a judge granted her fees for one part of the sprawling Hollywood case.
sources.title: Blake Lively Seeks $8 Million in Legal Bills in Dispute With Justin Baldoni

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Attorneys slam ‘scorched-earth tactics’ from Baldoni and Wayfarer Studios over $400m countersuit against the actor Blake Lively has filed for $8m in fees and costs that she says resulted from her battle against Justin Baldoni and his Wayfarer Studios. That figure is to cover the legal costs that Lively incurred from January to June 2025 in her fight against her director and co-star in the 2024 film It Ends With Us, as well as a petition for damages that was still pending when Lively v Baldoni was settled in May 2026. threads_text:
Blake Lively 申請追討 800 萬美元律師費

Blake Lively 向法院申請追討 800 萬美元的律師費。她在與導演 Justin Baldoni 的訴訟中就報復相關指控達成和解，法官此後裁定她有資格就其中一項申請費用補償。Baldoni 及其製作公司 Wayfarer Studios 的律師被批評採取「焦土戰術」——他們曾對她提出 4 億美元的反訴。

本則整理自 The New York Times 與 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 1 日發佈的報導。
